source.label: Tekken 3 move and combo archive
source.note: Commands use 1/2/3/4 notation. Land the starting attack before continuing a route. Some endings hit grounded opponents and depend on their recovery; timing, range and opponent size matter. 10 hit combos are preset strings, not guaranteed juggles. Data primarily from Tekken Wiki (Fandom) Tekken 3 movelists, cross-checked with contemporary guides.
